key_traps_discovered.trap: TPS79333DBVR Legacy (CSO:DLN) vs New Chip (CSO:RFB) Silicon Lottery & Pin 4 NR-to-NC Shift
key_traps_discovered.detail: Per SLVS348N p.3, p.5–7 & p.28, non-M3 TPS79333DBVR reels may ship either Legacy Chip (Pin 4 = bandgap NR via 250 kOhm, 33 uVRMS noise, 70 dB 10 kHz PSRR, 50 us startup, 170 uA typ / 220 uA max IQ, 6.0 V abs max, 0.1 uF CIN) or New Chip (Pin 4 = NC, 69 uVRMS noise, 49 dB 10 kHz PSRR, 500 us startup, 250 uA typ / 1000 uA max IQ, 6.5 V abs max, 1 uF CIN, 120 Ohm active discharge). Grounding Pin 4 collapses VOUT on Legacy Chip reels; Vision on Fig. 4-1 also caught that Table 4-1 lists OUT=6 (6-pin DBV only) while 5-pin TPS79333DBVR has OUT=5.

key_traps_discovered.trap: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 NRND Lifecycle Status, Severe 24 V SOT-23-5 Thermal Derating, & 2.5 mA EPNP IGND
key_traps_discovered.detail: 300 DPI PNG Vision confirmed DS37168 Rev. 6-3 red banner & watermarks ('NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGN — USE AP2205'). At SOT-23-5 θJA = 250 °C/W, dropping 24 V to 3.3 V caps continuous load to <= 19 mA at TA = 25°C (<= 7.7 mA at 85°C). EPNP bipolar base drive elevates IGND from 20 uA (0 A) to 2.5 mA at 150 mA, and full-load dropout is 360 mV typ / 500 mV max vs p.1 headline 100 mV @ 100 uA. Unlike TPS70933DBVR's 7 V EN clamp, AP2204's 38 V EN allows direct VIN tie.

key_traps_discovered.trap: TPS7A0533PDBVR Cold-Temp (< 15°C) Ramp-Down Glitch/130 ms Stall & Strict 3.6 V VOUT / 22 uF COUT Limits
key_traps_discovered.detail: Below 15°C ambient (Sec. 8.1.3, p.22–23), ramping VIN down faster than 10 ms triggers partial-startup double-pulsing, and ramping EN down faster than 100 us can cause up to a 130 ms startup delay. Additionally, VOUT abs max is min(VIN + 0.3 V, 3.6 V), VEN must not exceed VIN + 0.3 V, COUT is strictly capped at 22 uF max, IOUT >= 10 uA is required for accuracy, and output noise is 180 uVRMS with 1.5–2.8 ms startup.

key_traps_discovered.trap: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 Vision-Caught Overline 'Shutdown' Polarity, 250 °C/W Thermal Wall, & Page 11 ESR Plot Mismatch
key_traps_discovered.detail: Text extraction dropped the overbar over Pin 3 ('Shutdown'), which 300 DPI PNG Vision on p.1 & p.3 confirmed is active-low shutdown (= active-high EN, VIH >= 1.5 V, 3 MOhm pulldown, VCE <= VIN + 0.3 V). SOT-23-5 θJA = 250 °C/W caps PD(MAX) at 400 mW at 25°C (below the 510 mW needed for 5 V->3.3 V @ 300 mA). Page 11 ESR plots draw a black 'Min' line at ~0.25 Ohm (1 uF) / 0.1 Ohm (4.7 uF) despite p.1/p.12 low-ESR MLCC text.

key_traps_discovered.trap: TLV70233DBVR Non-P Missing Active Discharge, 249.2 °C/W RθJA, & Front-Page vs Table 6.5 Dropout Delta
key_traps_discovered.detail: TLV70233DBVR (marking 'QVD') lacks the 120 Ohm active discharge MOSFET found on TLV70233PDBVR (marking 'SLH'), enforces VEN <= min(VIN + 0.3 V, 6.0 V), has no reverse-current blocking, and reaches ΔT = 127°C at 5 V->3.3 V @ 300 mA (RθJA = 249.2 °C/W). Table 6.5 specifies 260 mV typ / 375 mV max dropout at 300 mA vs p.1 headline 220 mV.
